And this is what is said,

in the fruit of your womb, etc.";
and for this reason it is written "and He will give you abundance"
and it is not written in the future tense,
for this is already in the present:
יִפְתַּח ה׳ לְךָ אֶת אוֹצָרוֹ הַטּוֹב
"Hashem will open for you His good treasury";
this corresponds to the attribute of Gevurah,
for Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
"The Holy One, blessed be He, has nothing
אֶלָּא אוֹצָר שֶׁל יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם וְכוּלֵּי
but a treasury of the fear of Heaven, etc."
And this is the attribute of Yitzchak,
And it is written "His good treasury,"
it is written, "And the faith of your times shall be, etc." (Yeshayahu 33:6),
as referring to the six orders of the Mishnah,
"the fear of Hashem is his treasure."
And in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 30) it is brought
if you have fear of sin,
And this is what is said, "His good treasury":
the treasury that holds the words of Torah,
And it is written, "to give the rain of your land in its season
וּלְבָרֵךְ אֵת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ וְגוֹמֵר
and to bless all the work of your hand, etc.";
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא כה, ב)
this is based on what they said (Bava Basra 25b):
"And one who wishes to become rich should face north";
and we said that one who wishes
and that the wealth not harm him
he should hold fast to the attribute of fear,
And so we find great wealth
with Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and not the silver and gold of Avimelech."
"And Hashem will make you the head, etc.,"
corresponding to the attribute of Chesed,
for Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this attribute;
that he be at the head and above,
and they will remain so forever.
וְלָכֵן כְּתִיב גַּם כֵּן בִּלְשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה

But there it is only temporary,
relative to the nations of the world;

that it will be so forever.

is the seventh day of the week,
